core_meaning.short_meaning: Humayra; little reddish-brown one, a byname of Aisha
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Humeyra corresponds to the Arabic form حميراء (Arabic root ح م ر (ḥ-m-r); حُمَيْرَاء (Ḥumayrāʾ)). Its core sense is humayra; little reddish-brown one, a byname of aisha. Humeyra is a Turkish transliteration of Arabic حُمَيْرَاء (Ḥumayrāʾ) 'little reddish-brown one', a byname of Aisha, from the root ح م ر (ḥ-m-r). The source gloss 'Moonlight' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as humaira, humairaa, humairah, humayra and humera.
